title: Zeros curated model catalog
description: Drives the composer model picker's displayed list per agent family. Validated by `pnpm models:verify` + the catalog vitest test.

modelEnvVars.description: family → env var the chosen model id is written to

defaultFavorites.description: family → the curated model value new chats use when no favorite is selected. Must name a model in that family.

value.description: The exact, verbatim model id sent to the agent (per-agent format — Cursor uses dots, Droid uses dated snapshots, OpenCode uses provider/model). Run `pnpm models:list <agent>` to copy a real id.

liveRequired.description: Hide this curated row until exact live discovery marks it selectable.

minCliVersion.description: Minimum agent CLI version this model needs (e.g. Fable 5 → 2.1.170). Gated so it never silently downgrades on an older CLI.
